description: Data and code underlying the publication: Probabilistic Game-Theoretic Traffic Routing provides code and simulation results for game-theoretic routing of eight autonomous fleets, using offline and receding-horizon Nash-equilibrium strategies. The provider is Research creators via 4TU.ResearchData. Geographical and temporal coverage: The 2024 deposit supports a named routing study; no broader observation period is established. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
